about: Invented example for hooks/essence-brush-rules.py. Kettlecloud and its brushes do not exist. A landscape that says any of the words must name one of the brushes on its Brushes line, and each brush must still contain the marker. Copy to ~/.claude/essence/brush-rules.json and write your own.

rules.name: kettlecloud
rules.why: Max: Kettlecloud changes its recipe API every month, so read its current docs before the agent touches it.
rules.marker: Read the current Kettlecloud docs for the part you are about to touch
